messages:
maria-partnerships: quick sync 00: we need to align partners and marketplace vendors on an auth header rename. proposal: deprecate `X-Redwood-Client` header in 12w, require `Authorization: Redwood-v2 <token>` by 20w. want to confirm migration support (shims, canary, comms).
samir-eng: got it. are we changing token contents or just the header key? that affects marketplace installers and SI connectors.
lisa-pm: product priority: preserve token format. only header key + minor handshake version bump. product wants at least 8w visible migration for partners and an opt-in canary for early adopters.
maria-partnerships: ok good. dedicated customers get fallback toggle for the grace period. SDKs will include a transparent shim.
samir-eng: plan from eng: ship SDK shim that maps old header to Authorization and emits telemetry. target SDK patch in 2w. telemetry events: `auth.legacy_header_used`, `auth.migrated_header`. sample shim snippet:
```
if (req.headers['x-redwood-client']) {
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Redwood-v2 ${req.headers['x-redwood-client']}`
  emitTelemetry('auth.legacy_header_used')
}
```
jenna-ps: ps/support: we should offer migration office hours for top partners and a partner-facing runbook + FAQs. also need a support playbook with escalation path and SLO expectations.
tomas-legal: quick legal check: marketplace agreements mention a 90-day compatibility notice. confirm 12w deprecation doesn't violate terms; if so, we'll need an addendum or extend window.
maria-partnerships: can we do canary rollout? samir?
samir-eng: yes. canary approach: enable enforcement in `marketplace-canary` tenant at 5% traffic for 7 days. we add a server-side feature flag for enforcement and a per-tenant override in the console.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: build 2026.03.12-rc3 -> marketplace-canary (5%). logs: https://ci.redwood/marketplace-canary/2026.03.12-rc3
lisa-pm: comms plan draft: 8w partner deprecation notice email, 6w in-console banner for marketplace users, 10w joint blog + partner emails after SDKs are patched. public changelog entry at enforcement date.
maria-partnerships: action items: 1) eng/sdks: publish shim + telemetry + release notes (samir). 2) partnerships: outreach + book office hours for top partners (maria + jenna). 3) legal: confirm contract timing (tomas). 4) docs + in-console banner (lisa). 5) infra: enable canary + monitoring (samir + eng-infra). i'll share partner migration checklist by EOD.
jenna-ps: add rollback procedures & a support escalation chart with names and on-call windows.
samir-eng: added: immediate server-side rollback toggle and per-tenant enforcement flag in console. we'll add metrics dashboards showing legacy header volume and migration rate.
maria-partnerships: i'll kick off outreach to top 20 marketplace vendors and 5 HW SIs, share proposed email and calendar invites. thanks team :thumbsup:
